title: Morgan Stanley Form 8-K — Q1 2026 Earnings Disclosure
summary: Morgan Stanley filed a Form 8-K on April 15, 2026, disclosing Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition), referencing Q1 2026 earnings information released the same day. Exhibits include a press release and Financial Data Supplement for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. No macro catalysts or market structure content is present in this filing.
key_points: Form 8-K filed April 15, 2026, date of earliest event reported: April 15, 2026
Item 2.02 triggered: financial information for quarter ended March 31, 2026 released
Two exhibits attached: Exhibit 99.1 (press release) and Exhibit 99.2 (Financial Data Supplement)
Listed securities include common stock (MS), multiple preferred series (A, E, F, I, K, L, O, P, Q), and Global Medium-Term Notes Series A
Signed by Victoria Worster, Chief Accounting Officer and Controller
Information furnished under Item 2.02 deemed 'filed' for Securities Exchange Act purposes
